scope: Identity-based assembly and optional keyed feature output; no worker library source edits, splitter, model fitting or pilot work.

fixture_correction.diagnosis: The line=10 fixture yielded win/push/win, so expecting loss was incorrect. Changing the fixture line to 11 supplies push/loss/win and verifies the intended settlement cases.

real_data.reference: Independent Python dictionary joins on exact match/team/side identities; label values and feature values kept separate until reference construction.
real_data.limits: One pinned Premier League season; arithmetic/timing of upstream features and labels rely on their independently verified contracts. Synthetic checks cover missing future targets and identity collisions. No splitter or model.

signatures.ModelDataset: (X: object, y: object, metadata: object, layout: str, identity_columns: tuple[str, ...], match_columns: tuple[str, ...], target_perspective: str, definitions: dict = <factory>) -> None
signatures.evaluate_features: (history, features, *, group_by=('team_id', 'competition_id'), cutoffs=None, available_at=None, team_counts=None, ratings=None, team_seasons=None, season_starts=None, keyed=False)

equation_source_review.team_alignment: Exact match/team/side vector in selected label order.
equation_source_review.match_alignment: Independent verified home/away vectors concatenated in home-first order.
equation_source_review.missing_target_filter: Logical OR across selected target columns and all rows of the match; retain every row exactly when none is missing.
equation_source_review.groups: Each output row maps to its exact match tuple, repeated for complete team pairs.

rendering.method: Local KaTeX and marked with protected LaTeX delimiters; Playwright/Chrome at 1200px. Other viewers need compatible math support.

warnings: Existing pandas all-NA concatenation FutureWarning in the history test.
Existing Windows/ZMQ selector-thread RuntimeWarning during fresh notebook execution.
